levels.name: Open Gate
levels.hint: Tap a squad. Its sappers march from the camp and each eats the nearest pixel of their colour.

levels.name: The Waiting Line
levels.hint: Sappers who can't reach their colour wait on the holding line, and march on their own once it opens up.

levels.name: Woodpile
levels.hint: A squad bigger than what's open eats what it can reach. The rest wait, then finish the job.

levels.name: The Locked Bridge
levels.hint: The iron gate won't budge. Send the Looters for the gold key and the gate swings open.

levels.name: The Corner Tower
levels.hint: Sappers aimed inside the red ring get shot. Bring the tower down first.
